market_summary: Late New York session trading is characterized by widespread consolidation and volume dry-up across FX pairs (EURUSD, GBPUSD), precious metals (XAUUSD, XAGUSD), and US indices (US100). Gold and silver remain compressed beneath their session VWAP and value areas without breakout volume, while US100 trades mid-channel inside its value area beneath Gamma Flip resistance as equity cash close nears. Bitcoin maintains a persistent downtrend but is pressing directly into heavy multi-touch Session Low support at 71141 without RVOL expansion. Across all asset classes, confluence does not support high-probability momentum entries, favoring disciplined risk preservation on HOLD.
